title: My AI Experiments: Have I Been Duped?
description: Steven talks about getting AI to post his podcast intros to Instagram Stories and buying Gemini API credits as a "second pair of eyes," and asks whether all his AI spending is a smart career hedge or a con. He also wishes listeners a happy Thanksgiving, wonders who counts as "American," gives an update on grading student essays and teaching academic writing, and mentions a mystery brand email and a café near his home that closed.

sentences.zh: 内容速览
sentences.en: Content Overview

sentences.zh: 今天这期节目里，史蒂文聊了他最近的几项AI实验：先是让AI把播客开场自动发到Instagram快拍，然后终于咬咬牙买了Gemini的API额度。
sentences.en: In today's episode, Steven talks about his latest AI experiments: first, getting AI to automatically post the podcast intro to his Instagram Stories, and then finally biting the bullet and buying Gemini API credits.

sentences.zh: 节目还祝美国朋友感恩节快乐，顺便聊到“American”这个词到底指谁。
sentences.en: The episode also wishes American friends a happy Thanksgiving, and along the way discusses who the word "American" actually refers to.

sentences.zh: 他也坦率地问自己：花了这么多钱在AI上，是不是被人“忽悠”了？
sentences.en: He also frankly asks himself: having spent so much money on AI, has he been "conned"?

sentences.zh: 他还解释了为什么给自己定下一年期限。
sentences.en: He also explains why he set himself a one-year deadline.

sentences.zh: 最后聊到学生作文、一封神秘的品牌合作邮件，以及一家突然关门的咖啡店。
sentences.en: Finally, he talks about student essays, a mysterious brand partnership email, and a coffee shop that suddenly closed.

sentences.zh: 对着镜头说话（与提词器难题）
sentences.en: Talking to the Camera (and the Teleprompter Problem)

sentences.zh: 过去一周，史蒂文一直在训练一个AI助手，让它截取播客的第一分钟，加上旋转转场和字幕，做成Instagram快拍。
sentences.en: Over the past week, Steven has been training an AI assistant to take the first minute of the podcast, add a spin transition and subtitles, and turn it into an Instagram story.

sentences.zh: 麻烦在于，他录节目时总是低头看屏幕右下角的苹果备忘录。
sentences.en: The trouble is that when he records an episode, he keeps looking down at Apple Notes in the bottom-right corner of the screen.

sentences.zh: 摄像头是架在MacBook上方的iPhone，笔记没法放到镜头后面。
sentences.en: The camera is an iPhone mounted above his MacBook, so there's no way to put his notes behind the lens.

sentences.zh: 提词器要花钱，而每年这个时候，打赏有点少。
sentences.en: A teleprompter costs money, and at this time of year, tips are a bit low.

sentences.zh: 如果你愿意支持他，简介里有PayPal链接。
sentences.en: If you'd like to support him, there's a PayPal link in the description.

sentences.zh: 感恩节快乐，但“American”是什么意思？
sentences.en: Happy Thanksgiving, but what does "American" mean?

sentences.zh: 十一月第四个星期四，祝美国的朋友感恩节快乐！
sentences.en: The fourth Thursday of November: Happy Thanksgiving to our American friends!

sentences.zh: 有个学生在作文里写了“American”，而史蒂文作为加拿大人，对这个词总是左右为难。
sentences.en: A student wrote "American" in an essay, and as a Canadian, Steven always feels torn about this word.

sentences.zh: 他一直在教学生一个追问句：“What do you mean by…?”
sentences.en: He has always taught his students a follow-up question: "What do you mean by…?"

sentences.zh: （你说的……是什么意思？）朋友聊天、商务会议都能用。
sentences.en: (What do you mean by …?) You can use it chatting with friends or in business meetings.

sentences.zh: 所以他在作业上批了一句：“What do you mean by American?”
sentences.en: So he wrote a comment on the assignment: "What do you mean by American?"

segments.zh: What do you mean by American

sentences.zh: 严格来说，这个词可以指南北美洲的任何人，但他从没见过哪个智利人或阿根廷人一本正经地自称“American”。
sentences.en: Strictly speaking, the word can refer to anyone in North or South America, but he has never seen a Chilean or Argentine seriously call themselves "American."

sentences.zh: 对加拿大人来说，说自己是美国人，总觉得别扭。
sentences.en: For Canadians, calling themselves American always feels awkward.

sentences.zh: 这就是咬文嚼字的乐趣。
sentences.en: That's the fun of nitpicking over words.

sentences.zh: 黑色星期五，告别剪辑软件
sentences.en: Black Friday: saying goodbye to editing software

sentences.zh: 去年黑色星期五，他买了DaVinci Resolve和Final Cut Pro的Motion特效插件。
sentences.en: Last Black Friday, he bought DaVinci Resolve and Motion effects plug-ins for Final Cut Pro.

sentences.zh: DaVinci没学成，因为上手太难。
sentences.en: He never managed to learn DaVinci, because it was too hard to get started with.

sentences.zh: 如今Claude包办了不少剪辑工作，他不再需要更多视频剪辑软件，也不需要Descript了。
sentences.en: Now that Claude handles a lot of the editing work, he no longer needs any more video editing software, and he doesn't need Descript anymore either.

sentences.zh: 那还需要视频剪辑师吗？
sentences.en: So are video editors still needed?

sentences.zh: 今天他花了大约一小时，处理13段各45秒左右的片段。
sentences.en: Today he spent about an hour working on 13 clips, each roughly 45 seconds long.

sentences.zh: 他说：“这正是我担心的。我就是不想再看自己的脸了。”
sentences.en: He said: "This is exactly what I was worried about. I just don't want to look at my own face anymore."

sentences.zh: 而Claude可以一次搞定这13段。
sentences.en: Claude, on the other hand, can take care of all 13 clips in one go.

sentences.zh: “这怎么比？”
sentences.en: "How can you even compare?"

sentences.zh: 用Meta的Muse自动发Instagram
sentences.en: Using Meta's Muse to auto-post on Instagram

sentences.zh: 他的第一个Instagram账号，因为机器人式发帖被封了。
sentences.en: His first Instagram account was banned for bot-like posting.

sentences.zh: 现在他用Muse给自己的账号（Sirski Steven）自动发帖：
sentences.en: Now he uses Muse to auto-post to his own account (Sirski Steven):

sentences.zh: 他把节目放进文件夹，Claude把它剪成13或15个片段。
sentences.en: He puts the episode into a folder, and Claude cuts it into 13 or 15 clips.

sentences.zh: 开场视频传到Google Drive，Drive通知Meta的Muse。
sentences.en: The intro video is uploaded to Google Drive, and Drive notifies Meta's Muse.

sentences.zh: Muse等Spotify链接出现在Google表格里，再把开场和节目封面发到快拍，并附上可点击的链接。
sentences.en: Muse waits for the Spotify link to appear in a Google Sheet, then posts the intro and episode cover to Stories, with a clickable link attached.

sentences.zh: 这花了他整整一周，但效果惊人。
sentences.en: This took him a whole week, but the results are amazing.

sentences.zh: 他以前每月花约22美元买Metricool，现在自己的页面不再需要了。
sentences.en: He used to spend about $22 a month on Metricool, but now he no longer needs it for his own page.

sentences.zh: Gemini额度与“第二双眼睛”
sentences.en: Gemini Credits and a "Second Pair of Eyes"

sentences.zh: 昨天那期节目之后，他买了约32美元的Gemini API额度。
sentences.en: After yesterday's episode, he bought about 32 dollars' worth of Gemini API credits.

sentences.zh: Gemini在中国被屏蔽，但这里的聪明工程师想出了办法。
sentences.en: Gemini is blocked in China, but clever engineers here have found a way around it.

sentences.zh: Whisper负责转录，Claude负责剪辑、片段和Substack文章，而Gemini做质量检查：用他的口吻改写文章，还能检查视频。
sentences.en: Whisper handles transcription, Claude handles editing, clips and Substack articles, and Gemini does quality checks: it rewrites articles in his voice and can also check videos.

sentences.zh: Gemini还在审查他的英语教学漫画，有些漫画在第一格就泄露了答案。
sentences.en: Gemini is also reviewing his English-teaching comics, some of which give away the answer in the very first panel.

sentences.zh: 他的目标是为五六个品牌打造一支“内容大军”，其中三个是英语教学品牌。
sentences.en: His goal is to build a "content army" for five or six brands, three of which are English-teaching brands.

sentences.zh: 给职业生涯买一份“看跌期权”
sentences.en: Buying a "put option" on your career

sentences.zh: 为什么要花这些钱？
sentences.en: Why spend this money?

sentences.zh: 目标是让工作自动化，至少别完全依赖它。
sentences.en: The goal is to automate his work, or at least not depend on it completely.

sentences.zh: 他把这看作给职业生涯买的“看跌期权”，万一待不下去中国，还有条退路。
sentences.en: He sees it as buying a "put option" on his career: if he can't stay in China, he'll still have a way out.

sentences.zh: 有人说“史蒂夫，你被忽悠了”？
sentences.en: Someone says, "Steve, you've been conned"?

sentences.zh: 他不能完全反驳。
sentences.en: He can't fully argue against that.

sentences.zh: 所以他把Gemini的预算限制在每月20美元左右。
sentences.en: So he limits his Gemini budget to about 20 dollars a month.

sentences.zh: 他给自己一年时间，到下一个美国感恩节为止。
sentences.en: He's giving himself a year, until next American Thanksgiving.

sentences.zh: 他对Claude说：“这算是反内容吧。”
sentences.en: He said to Claude: "I guess this counts as anti-content."

sentences.zh: “一个人想超越茶水间闲聊的尝试。”
sentences.en: "One person's attempt to go beyond water-cooler chat."

sentences.zh: 那当老板的滋味如何？
sentences.en: So how does it feel to be the boss?

sentences.zh: “糟透了。目前还不赚钱。”
sentences.en: "Terrible. It's not making money yet."

sentences.zh: 投资回报为负，但收获了经验
sentences.en: The return on investment is negative, but he gained experience

sentences.zh: 眼下，投资回报是负的。
sentences.en: For now, the return on investment is negative.

sentences.zh: 他父亲会说，看看你学到了多少。
sentences.en: His father would say: look at how much you've learned.

sentences.zh: 他的建议是：花每月30美元认真试试AI，推荐Claude Cowork。
sentences.en: His advice: spend $30 a month and give AI a real try; he recommends Claude Cowork.

sentences.zh: 他待过的公司，没有一家给过他信用卡，所以想学广告投放，只能自己掏钱上手。
sentences.en: None of the companies he worked at ever gave him a credit card, so if he wanted to learn ad buying, he had to pay out of his own pocket and dive in.

sentences.zh: 他近两年前辞职，原因之一就是自己永远不会升到管理层。
sentences.en: He quit his job almost two years ago, partly because he would never be promoted to management.

sentences.zh: 他一个人工作，从不觉得孤单。
sentences.en: He works alone and never feels lonely.

sentences.zh: 女朋友正在做晚饭。
sentences.en: His girlfriend is making dinner.

sentences.zh: 谢谢你，亲爱的。
sentences.en: Thank you, dear.

sentences.zh: “重要的不是钱，而是学到的经验。”
sentences.en: "What matters isn't the money, but the experience you gain."

sentences.zh: 学生作文与学术语体
sentences.en: Student essays and academic register

sentences.zh: 作文批完了吗？
sentences.en: Has he finished grading the essays?

sentences.zh: 没有。
sentences.en: No.

sentences.zh: 他从早上九点干到下午两点，刚好批完一半，所以告诉学生，希望周五前完成。
sentences.en: He worked from nine in the morning until two in the afternoon and got exactly halfway through, so he told the students he hoped to finish by Friday.

sentences.zh: 他还备了课：
sentences.en: He also prepared lessons:

sentences.zh: 一份分成两部分的阅读听力小测
sentences.en: A two-part reading and listening quiz

sentences.zh: 一节学术语体课：不用缩写，不用“你”或“我们”，不写“在我看来”。
sentences.en: A lesson on academic register: no contractions, no "you" or "we", no "in my opinion".

sentences.zh: 用他的话说，就是“鼻孔朝天、自命清高的那种文风”。
sentences.en: In his words, it's "that nose-in-the-air, holier-than-thou style of writing".

sentences.zh: 为了讲清语体，他问学生：跟院长或华为CEO说话，你会怎么讲？
sentences.en: To explain register clearly, he asked the students: how would you talk to a dean or Huawei's CEO?

sentences.zh: 神秘品牌邮件与关门的咖啡店
sentences.en: A mysterious brand email and a coffee shop that closed

sentences.zh: 几年前他做过视频介绍的一款语言学习App发来邮件，想谈合作。
sentences.en: A language-learning app he had made a video about a few years ago sent him an email wanting to discuss a partnership.

sentences.zh: 邮件看着像模板，但对方客服确认确有其事。
sentences.en: The email looked like a template, but their customer service confirmed it was genuine.

sentences.zh: 他回了信，至今没有下文。
sentences.en: He replied, but he still hasn't heard anything back.

sentences.zh: 与此同时，他家附近的咖啡酒吧Good Things关门了，厨房也被拆空。
sentences.en: Meanwhile, Good Things, a coffee bar near his home, closed down, and its kitchen was stripped bare.

sentences.zh: 它的三明治卖78到100元。
sentences.en: Its sandwiches sold for 78 to 100 yuan.

sentences.zh: 他一直想去尝尝，却始终没去成。
sentences.en: He had always wanted to try them but never managed to go.

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's summary

sentences.zh: 这些AI折腾眼下也许在亏钱，但史蒂文正借此弄清自己能不能做出属于自己的事业，一年后见分晓。
sentences.en: These AI experiments may be losing money right now, but Steven is using them to figure out whether he can build a business of his own — we'll know in a year.

sentences.zh: 祝大家感恩节快乐，也祝他批作文顺利。
sentences.en: Happy Thanksgiving, everyone, and good luck to him with grading essays.

vocab.en: to grit one's teeth, to bite the bullet
in all seriousness, with a straight face
